I used this workflow for faceswapping with my Lora trained Characters. SAM2 is good for tracking the mask through the video.

1. Run the video through and get first frame (for masking) and then cancel the run immediately (or you can use the switches)


2. the first frame should now be in the points editor in SAM2. Manually add points to mask out the part you want changed e.g. face.

3. Add your lora and your prompt in.

4. Then run it agian this time let it finish. Keep and eye on the masking to be sure it does what you want.
<- To learn how to use this click the tool tip!

For my uses I find "Grow mask with blur", "expand" setting is best at 1 or 2 sometimes 5, for faces. Too large and the heads came out too big.
